visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium-sized tan dog with a light blue collar stands on a brown wooden slatted balcony floor near a sliding glass door. The dog is seen from a high angle, sniffing a pair of white and grey sandals. Bright natural daylight fills the scene. (2) The dog looks up at the camera with an inquisitive expression, its dark eyes prominent. A person's hand briefly enters the frame from the left to point at the ground. The background shows an indoor office-like space with white desks and chairs. (3) The dog sits obediently on the wooden floor as a human hand, wearing a grey jacket sleeve, holds a small yellow cubic snack between two fingers. The camera moves in for a medium close-up of the dog's focused face and the treat. (4) The dog gently takes the yellow snack from the human's open palm. The background remains slightly out of focus, showing a clean indoor living area through the glass door. (5) The human shows their empty, open palm to the dog. The dog lowers its head and ears slightly, sniffing the hand and looking down at the deck, appearing to look for more snacks. (6) The human's hand reaches out to rub the dog's chin. Small animated brown heart icons appear above the dog's head as it looks content and leans its chin into the person's hand. (7) The video transitions to a solid pink background with the white text logo "好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR" centered on the screen, concluding the visual sequence.
